scripts.l10n: echo Generating app_localizations_xx.dart from app_xx.arb; cd app && flutter gen-l10n
scripts.server-dev-new: rm -fr server/data/einz.sqlite.db* && rm -fr server/data/files && npm run server-dev
scripts.server-prod: cd deployment; git pull; docker compose up -d --build server; docker compose down; docker compose up -d; docker compose logs -f server
scripts.server-prod-new: rm -fr deployment/data/einz.sqlite.db* && rm -fr deployment/data/files && npm run server-prod
scripts.ios-deps: cd app && flutter pub get && cd ios && pod install
scripts.build-and-install-ios-adhoc-stepbystep: ls ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/; cd app; flutter build ipa --release --export-options-plist=ios/exportOptionsAdhoc.plist; ls -la build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa; xcrun devicectl list devices; rm -rf /tmp/einz-ipa && mkdir -p /tmp/einz-ipa; unzip -q build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa -d /tmp/einz-ipa; xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008030-0005306011F9402E /tmp/einz-ipa/Payload/Runner.app
scripts.apk-run-dev-new: cd app; flutter install -d emulator-5554; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=local_config.android.json
scripts.apk-run-prod-new: cd app; flutter install -d emulator-5554; flutter run -d emulator-5554
scripts.ios-boot: xcrun simctl boot 720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B; open -a Simulator; xcrun simctl list devices | grep -i booted
scripts.ios-run-dev-new: xcrun simctl uninstall booted cc.tic.einz; cd app; flutter run -d 720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B --dart-define-from-file=local_config.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.ios-run-prod-new: xcrun simctl uninstall booted cc.tic.einz; cd app; flutter run -d 720C22F9-D844-44EE-BDA6-87900913A39B --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter.pid
scripts.ios-refresh: echo '热重载（只刷新界面，不重置状态）'; kill -USR1 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
scripts.ios-reload: echo '热重启（重启逻辑，重新走启动流程——适合本次改动，能看到进入对话页的最新效果）'; kill -USR2 $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter.pid)
